Therefore, it is mathematically correct to proceed to solve (30) with the complex extension of the same tools used in the numerical method for the Diffusion Equation. Numerical methods 13 solve the PDE by transforming the integral problem into an algebraic one that is computationally accessible. The Crank-Nicholson method is the preferred numerical algorithm used to solve the Schrödinger equation as a diffusion type equation. It is an implicit algorithm valid through second order in both space and time coordinates, so it is very stable 13 .
